# Generated CLI snippets

Files in this directory are written by `make docs-cli` and included into
`docs/src/cli/*.md` via mdbook's `{{#include}}` directive.

**Do not edit by hand.** CI fails if these snippets diverge from
`./bwa-mem3 <subcommand> --help` output.

To regenerate after a CLI flag change:

```bash
make docs-cli
git add docs/_generated/cli
git commit -m "docs(cli): regenerate --help snippets"
```
